title: ONT SQK-RBK114.96 amplicon barcoding and library prep (RAA_9198_v114_revM)

reagents.name: Rapid Barcodes RB01-96 (plate, 5 ul per well)

steps.text: Optional PCR clean-up of amplicons (method left open by the document)
steps.source_quote: We recommend performing a purification step following the PCR reaction

steps.text: Normalise each amplicon to 50 ng in 9 ul (dilution table)
steps.source_quote: amplicon DNA is required in 9 µl of volume for each sample

steps.text: Add 1 ul of a unique Rapid Barcode to each sample and mix
steps.source_quote: Rapid Barcodes (RB01-96, one for each sample) 1 μ l

steps.text: Incubate 30 C for 2 min then 80 C for 2 min on a thermal cycler, cool on ice, spin down
steps.source_quote: Incubate the tubes or plate at 30°C for 2 minutes and then at 80°C for 2

steps.text: Pool 10 ul of every barcoded sample (960 ul for 96)
steps.source_quote: Pool all the barcoded samples into a clean 1.5 or 2 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind

steps.text: Equal-volume AXP clean-up of the pool: Hula 10 min, magnet, two 1.5 ml 80% ethanol washes, dry 30 s, elute in 15 ul EB for 10 min, keep 15 ul eluate
steps.source_quote: add an equal volume of resuspended AMPure XP Beads (AXP)

steps.text: Quantify 1 ul of eluate on a Qubit
steps.source_quote: Quantify 1 µl of eluted sample using a Qubit fluorometer.

steps.text: Take 11 ul of library (max 800 ng) into a clean tube
steps.source_quote: Transfer 11 µl of the sample into a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.text: Dilute RA (1.5 ul RA + 3.5 ul ADB) and add 1 ul to the library, incubate 5 min at room temperature
steps.source_quote: Add 1 µl of the diluted Rapid Adapter (RA) to the barcoded DNA.

steps.text: Prime and load the MinION flow cell
steps.source_quote: Priming and loading the MinION and GridION Flow Cell

notes: The pooled clean-up (s6) and adapter steps (s8, s9) are tube-scale (960 ul + 960 ul beads, 1.5 ml washes); on a deck without a tube magnet they are operator steps.
s1 (PCR clean-up) volumes are not given by the document; a standard AMPure clean-up is an acceptable automation choice.
